entity.name: Jai
entity.description: I'm Jai, an independent developer in India. I started Rigby2D in 2026 and build it around a day job: the editor, the engine runtimes, the documentation, the tutorials and the community. Funding buys back the hours Rigby2D gets, until it is my full-time job.

projects.name: Rigby2D
projects.description: A free, open-source 2D skeletal animation editor for games and film, with runtimes for Godot, Unity, Defold, Phaser, PixiJS, Cocos Creator, Ren'Py and SDL3, and a Rust core. It reads and writes the skeleton JSON and binary formats that game studios already use, so teams can move their existing rigs to an open tool without rebuilding them. Every runtime is tested against the editor frame by frame. Animators get bones, meshes, IK, physics, skins, layered playback with crossfades and film rendering, without a per-seat license. Desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux, a browser editor, a command line and an MCP server for AI agents.
